description: The nextbrief plugin, served from the engine's own repository.

plugins.name: nextbrief
plugins.description: The portfolio context an agent should read before it starts work: what projects exist, what each one is for, what is open, and what was just closed. Read-only. Ships the skill only: the nextbrief engine installs separately with `pipx install nextbrief` or `uv tool install nextbrief`.
